title: MSAA 내부 분할의 중간 resolve 생략
existingWork: 중간 조각/최종 조각을 encoder 생성 전에 구분하는 계획이 미구현.
missingEvidence: 현재 AA Off 비교의 창 조건만으로 offscreen sample 수를 알 수 없고 절감 빈도·비용 미확정.
requiredBoundary: 마지막 draw 없는 종료에서도 최종 resolve 보장, memoryless/private backing/visibility/query/alias 예외 유지.

risk.function: 매우높음: 마지막 draw 없는 종료에서도 최종 resolve가 필요. storeAction만 Store로 변경하는 안은 과거Metal검증 실패와 동일 반례.
risk.lifetime: 매우높음: memoryless/Private backing, resolve 대상의 동시읽기/alias, depth/stencil sample 수명.
risk.synchronization: 높음: query/visibility/timestamp와 중간/최종 fragment 판정 순서.
risk.memory: 모든pass를 store후 별도resolve로 만들면 unbroken pass에도 추가encoder/StoreLoad를 부과.

strategy: Only for a proven repeated internal MSAA split, pre-classify fragments and the final consumer before encoder creation. Resolve exactly when required, including final termination without another draw. Unknown/memoryless/alias/visibility cases retain existing resolves. No unconditional extra Store/Load or final encoder.
acceptance: A concrete group11 split with multisampled offscreen attachments is observed
Intermediate consumers, memoryless/private lifetime and final resolve ownership are explicit
AA Off window setting is not proof all offscreen attachments are single-sample
tests: Existing suspend-resolve and visibility recycle CPU/native cases
No-final-draw, depth/stencil, alias/readback, memoryless and one-unbroken-pass regressions
dependencyMeaning: Interactions require re-review; they are not permission to enable all related changes together.
designStage: Exact source capsules where named; broader missing-target/ownership/pass designs remain gated where stated
stopRule: Any unclosed correctness/lifetime counterexample, changed parent, failed check or unclear measurement stops this module. Preserve failure evidence; no automatic replay.
rollback: Prepared source module: exact reverse patch only against its postimage, refresh mtimes and rebuild all affected headers. No-code module: active product remains unchanged; no invented reverse patch.
